project: Atelier — August 6th updates — W8 Colour files
description:
Import the 18 supplier colour spreadsheets into the colourway catalogue, with 2026 rates as a secondary output.

Epic: _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/epics.md (Epic 8)
Architecture: _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/architecture.md
Requires: W10 Pricing template merged — its rate output is emitted in that template shape
Blocks: nothing

userStories.title: Adapter registry and the row-extraction harness
userStories.description: As the platform, I want each supplier layout declared rather than guessed.
acceptanceCriteria: A registry keyed by filename prefix declares sheet names, header row and column map
The header row is located by MATCHING LABELS, never a fixed index — Jim Thompson header is on row 2, Clarence House is buried under terms text
The harness reuses scripts/lib/{zip,xml,xlsx,text}.js and adds no dependency
An unknown file is reported as unsupported, never silently skipped
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Adapters for the single-sheet, single-brand files
userStories.description: As the platform, I want the straightforward files importing first.
acceptanceCriteria: Covers at least Jean Monro, Madeaux, Liberty, Maria Flora and the Perennials pair
Each adapter yields brand, design, supplier colour code and colour name
A fixture test asserts the first three rows of each file map correctly
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Adapters for the multi-sheet and multi-brand files
userStories.description: As the platform, I want the awkward files handled explicitly.
acceptanceCriteria: Colefax carries four brands in one sheet, keyed by its Brand column
Jannelli & Volpi spans ten sheets and eight brands
Pierre Frey carries five houses; Jim Thompson has a banner row above the header
Clarence House has two sheets and a terms preamble
The de Le Cuona PDF is reported as unsupported with a clear reason
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Normalised output, loud failure, per-file summary
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a run that either succeeds completely or tells me exactly what is wrong.
acceptanceCriteria: Any unmappable row aborts THAT FILE with a file:sheet:row list and writes nothing
A summary reports rows in, colourways out, and skips by reason
Output lands under incoming/ (gitignored), never in src/seed/data/ — this is client data
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Rates as a secondary output
userStories.description: As the office, I want the 2026 rates these files carry, in the pricing template shape.
acceptanceCriteria: Rate rows are emitted in the universal template column order
A row with no usable rate is skipped and counted, not defaulted to zero
duty and freight class letters are carried RAW and uninterpreted — no placeholder is invented
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Import colourways into products and colourways
userStories.description: As the platform, I want the extracted colourways in the database.
acceptanceCriteria: Upserts on the colourway SKU, matching the existing seed posture
The supplier colour code is NEVER joined to price_list_items.code — they are different codes
Validation rejects the batch before any SQL, as the legacy import does
The whole import is one transaction and re-running changes nothing
Brands that do not exist are reported, never created silently
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`
